question.text: (+)-2-chloro-2-phenylethane in toluene racemises slowly in the presence of small amount of $\mathrm{SbCl}_{5},$ due to the formation of

solution.text: A planar carbocation is generated when $\mathrm{SbCl}_{5}$ remove $\mathrm{Cl}^{-}$ from the substrate. This carbocation is subsequently attacked by $\mathrm{Cl}^{-}$ (nucleophile) from both the sides (j.e. from top and bottom) to produce a racemic mixture.
